title: What can go wrong

blocks.what_we_do: Collect the common problems of imputation in one table.
blocks.why:
| Problem | Likely cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Many sites removed for allele mismatch | Strand problems or wrong genome build | Repeat steps 2.5 and 2.6; check the REF alleles (step A.7) |
| Low R2 everywhere | The panel does not match the ancestry, or wrong build | Choose another panel; check the build |
| The job fails on upload | File not compressed with bgzip, unsorted, or wrong chromosome names | Write the VCF again (step A.7) |
| Lost results password | Password not saved | The server does not keep it: run the job again |
| Job deleted before download | Results are kept for 7 days | Download as soon as you get the email |
| Imputed hit not seen in the measured data | Low R2, or a real signal at an unmeasured site | Check R2; look at LD with measured neighbours; confirm by direct genotyping |
blocks.command: No code to run. This is a reading-only step.
blocks.expected_result: You can match each problem with its likely cause.
blocks.troubleshooting: For a problem that is not in the table, read the documentation page of your server and the log files of the job.
blocks.quick_check:
A colleague gets a low R2 for almost every variant, common ones too. What two causes would you check first?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

The genome build of the input against that of the panel, and the ancestry of the study against that of the panel.

</details>
